tasks.commitBody: The prepped state joins the board's active float, sorting between in process and in research — the float reads the lifecycle backwards, nearest-to-done first, so the top of the board answers what is closest to landing. The change is one element inserted into the ordered label list: precedence for an issue carrying more than one label falls out of list order through the existing findIndex rank, which is why the list is ordered at all. The chip needed nothing — the board has painted every label in its own GitHub colour since the colour work landed. The coupling comment at the site now names all three exact strings and records that its own warning has already come true once: this state was renamed from researched to prepped within two minutes of its creation, before it had reached the code, and the next rename will not announce itself either. A stale prepped label on a closed issue still cannot reorder finished work. STATED CHOICES: <GREEN agent fills>.
